text.tspan: FAO projections of arable land World, 1961 to 2050
Land allocated to arable production or permanent crops, measured in hectares. Values from 2030 onwards are
FAO's 2018 projections under three different scenarios.

tspan.tspan: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2025); Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (2018)
